rationale: External runtime drivers may produce tens/hundreds or more changes per second; runtime transitions are not automatically Grape editing intent.
A single chronological stream risks burying semantic document edits and increases memory, receipts, synchronization and conflict costs.
Do not merge independent authorities before defining which operations have user-intent-level Undo semantics.

rules.text: Graph History records semantic canonical document transactions; explicit command/editing domain determines Ctrl+Z. Canvas/committed model Inspector use Graph; Host/live controls use their own domain. No eligible/empty domain must not fall back globally. Panel has no History authority by virtue of presentation; draft/text editing is local until commit.

Successful Graph Undo restores canonical/default value. Active Binding attempts a new conditional live write of restored value after model commit; no second Graph History entry or cross-domain rewind. No active binding means model-only.

Verify Host authority, lease, load/epoch/incarnation, field identity/shape/driver and expected revision/basis at the existing write boundary. Missing/invalid basis or stale receipt conflicts; do not force-overwrite or silently rebase from external readback to make Undo succeed. Binding uses the applicable existing intent/receipt basis; a newer observation alone does not renew an Undo-derived write authority. This applies even when the external update and readback happened before Graph Undo began. Runtime credentials stay outside Graph History.
Live write conflict/divergence never rolls back completed Graph Undo or delays its cursor until Host confirmation. Canonical/default and actual value may differ; Binding exposes divergence.

Grape-originated Host/live Undo retains own-domain receipt/conditional-write/readback/conflict semantics. TD-originated Undo/external operations only affect runtime/readback; no Graph History entry or attempt to rewind TD History.

High-frequency runtime observation updates runtime/readback/basis only: no Graph History or implicit application Undo entry, canonical dirty/redo mutation or echo command, absent a future explicitly defined user-intent operation.
Keep LU-UI-009, stale receipt, load/epoch/Target lifetime fences, Host authority, receiving-side checks and CAS. Old reply cannot alter new document, dirty, render or History context.
Do not implement a cross-domain coordinator, partial coordinator, hidden mode, feature flag or experimental toggle.
Artifact publication still preserves compatible Host current values. The new trigger uses the existing conditional live-input path; resetSourceIds/default replay is not a substitute.

acceptanceCases.name: Graph Undo is not TD history rewind
acceptanceCases.given: Canonical model was edited; TD performed an external operation/Undo; Graph History has an eligible edit.
acceptanceCases.then: Canonical model restores through Graph History. TD-originated history cursor and external animation are not rewound. Any active-binding propagation is a new conditional write.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Host/live Undo is not Graph Undo
acceptanceCases.given: A Grape-originated Host/native/live operation has a valid receipt; canonical/default value and Graph history are captured.
acceptanceCases.when: Undo only the explicit Host/live domain.
acceptanceCases.then: Only owned eligible Host records change. Canonical/default value, Graph revision/dirty/history/redo stay unchanged.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: High-frequency observations are not editing transactions
acceptanceCases.given: Graph has a Redo branch and a known serialized snapshot; Host has external drivers.
acceptanceCases.when: Feed at least 10000 observations including animation and TD Undo readback.
acceptanceCases.then: Mirror/runtime basis updates correctly; no Graph or application Undo entries, Graph dirty/revision/redo changes, or echo writes. This bounded test is not a throughput claim.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Stale basis cannot be forced by Undo
acceptanceCases.given: An existing applicable Binding intent/receipt basis and canonical edit are available; Graph Undo would propagate a conditional live write.
acceptanceCases.when: Exercise both orders: (1) capture write basis then external change before commit; (2) external animation/TD Undo and mirror readback happen before Graph Undo starts. Change value/driver/shape/revision; include A-to-B-to-A values.
acceptanceCases.then: Invalidated applicable basis causes refusal/conflict; Graph Undo stays committed and Host external result remains. Latest mirror alone does not renew authority. No value-only equality shortcut, silent fresh-basis retry or force-write.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Live conflict does not roll back Graph Undo
acceptanceCases.given: Canonical 2-to-1 Undo commits; actual Host state has diverged.
acceptanceCases.when: Deliver conflict for the new conditional live write.
acceptanceCases.then: Canonical=1; Graph cursor already advanced and revision increased; no extra Graph entry/rollback. Host external actual value retained; Binding exposes divergence.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Ctrl+Z obeys command/editing domain
acceptanceCases.given: Canvas, committed Inspector, uncommitted text/IME draft, Host/live control, and no eligible/empty history domain can have focus.
acceptanceCases.when: Dispatch Ctrl+Z with newer edits available in a different domain.
acceptanceCases.then: Only explicit domain/local-draft semantics apply. No global-most-recent fallback or Panel-owned History. Draft editing creates no Graph entry until commit.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Old document/binding replies are inert
acceptanceCases.given: Native/live restore, Undo propagation or publication receipt is pending.
acceptanceCases.when: Load a new document via UI and non-UI entry, rebind to new epoch, or restart Target incarnation; then release each old response.
acceptanceCases.then: Old response cannot mutate new document, dirty, render, or Graph/Host History context. No lease/token revival. Receiver fences remain required; client discard does not prove physical remote cancellation.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Successful propagation is a new conditional intent
acceptanceCases.given: Active binding has valid expected basis and authority; model edit can Undo; repeat with no binding.
acceptanceCases.when: Commit Graph Undo, then complete conditional live write; observe concurrent artifact publication separately.
acceptanceCases.then: Graph restore completes first. Live path has new request/intent identity and does not append Graph History or replay old receipt. No binding yields zero Host calls. Publication preserves compatible actual values, never resets defaults to implement this propagation.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Own-domain confirmation/retry/no-op
acceptanceCases.given: A Host-domain Undo has valid receipt; capture its stack and unrelated Graph state.
acceptanceCases.when: Delay, reject, retry same payload, duplicate receipt, change reused payload, or make outcome indeterminate; exercise no-op/cancel/Redo.
acceptanceCases.then: Only confirmed own-domain success advances that stack. Same request+payload has no repeated side effect; changed payload rejected. Unknown outcome blocks related Host writes for readback. Already committed Graph Undo stands. Own-domain no-op preserves Redo; no shared global Redo.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

acceptanceCases.name: Reload/save boundaries survive deferral
acceptanceCases.given: LC-UI-101 confirm/cancel/draft cases and restored canonical value exist; runtime differs.
acceptanceCases.when: Exercise cancel, fetch failure, accepted replacement, stale replies, and canonical save/reload.
acceptanceCases.then: Original reload confirmation/guard/failure requirements retained (G-LU-UI-008 not presumed solved). Successful load has new lifetime and reset session state; stale callbacks do not revive it. Save contains canonical value, not runtime mirror/leases/History/divergence; binding authority must be re-established.
acceptanceCases.validationMethod: Production acceptance: controlled model/router/receiver fixtures; add isolated real TD/adapter evidence for each claimed native/runtime behavior. Fake or reference tests alone do not close native Gates.

protectedObligations: snapshot persistence / no runtime History or lease serialization

architectureCheck.reasoning: Existing Graph/Host/Binding authority, mutation, asynchronous lifecycle and persistence boundaries already separate. This Product Decision narrows scope and sets trigger policy; it does not merge or transfer authority.
architectureCheck.explicitTextReconciliation: HOST_QUALIFICATION_CONTRACTS section3 prohibition on publication restoring runtime defaults remains. Graph Undo propagation is a separate new section4 conditional live-input intent, not resetSourceIds or old receipt replay. Broad no-propagation interpretation and mixed combined-success product requirement are explicitly superseded only to that extent.
